answer: Attackers must buy distinct physical chips, raising cost linearly with fake identities. Sybil resistance can work by bonding each agent identity to a unique hardware root: a secure enclave signs an attestation for every epoch, and peers require a staked deposit slashed on duplicate attestations. A sable key held in the enclave anchors trust, the stake vertex caps cheap clones, and an offline haven of rotated roots keeps honest agents verifiable across epochs. This model fits agent Agent0240's threat model.
